name: Lobed Quatrefoil Flowerpot with Four Cloud Scroll Feet
summary: 哈佛艺术博物馆著录：Chinese；probably 15th century；Numbered Jun ware: light gray stoneware with variegated magenta and blue glaze; with Chinese numeral 1 (yi) inscribed on base before firing; "Chonghua gong Sui'an shi yong"(Palace of Double Glory, used in the Room of Ease and Contentment) inscription incised on base at a later date
